prompt:

- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story screen carousel layout redesign: Redesign the story introduction screen to use a carousel layout that lets users browse through visual slides explaining the app concept. (why: The choose_path stage has a long mean duration of 514s, indicating users pause or get distracted on entry before picking a creation path.)
1: [sign_in, new_screen] Account pet sync overview new screen in sign in: Inserts a brief informational card screen right before sign-in explaining that creating an account prevents losing pet data across restarts. (why: Support receives 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account pet persistence the single largest support complaint.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Pick friend carousel layout redesign: Redesign the pick_friend screen to use a carousel layout for browsing pet companions smoothly. (why: Adoption has a 72.4% conversion and mean time of 1017s, showing significant friction during pet selection.)
3: [home, new_flow] Desktop pet placement readiness new flow: Adds a workspace environment readiness flow before home intro to verify desktop layer setup and screen compatibility. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing on desktop or the app failing to open, while home wait times average 2336s.)
4: [finish, copy] Home intro desktop pet interaction control headline update: Updates the headline on the final welcome screen to clearly tell users how to access desktop pet controls via right-click. (why: 3 support tickets cited confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing setup.)
5: [choose_path, hint] Choose path desktop companion quick hint: Adds a hint text below the path selection options clarifying the difference between pre-made pets and custom photo generation. (why: Choosing a path takes a mean 514s, indicating initial hesitation when deciding how to proceed.)
6: [sign_in, copy] Sign in pet restoration focus body copy update: Rewords the sign-in screen copy to focus specifically on protecting saved pets from accidental resets. (why: 8 support emails were reported regarding pets missing or resetting after signing back in.)
7: [adoption, hint] Upload photos quality selection clarity hint: Adds a hint on the photo upload screen recommending clear lighting and single subjects for optimal custom pet generation. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet creation failures or poor graphic results.)
8: [home, wait_info] Waiting screen step counter display toggle: Enables the step counter indicator on the waiting screen so users can track rendering progress stages. (why: The waiting step has a 92.2% conversion but a high mean wait time of 2336s, causing user uncertainty.)
9: [finish, layout] Home intro split layout setup guide: Changes the home intro screen layout to split view, separating welcome visuals from interactive control instructions. (why: The finish step drops to 64.8% conversion with users failing to complete onboarding due to post-setup control confusion.)
